duplicate_symbol_policy: sum all matching features before normalization

T0.purpose: same scoring transform across A0, A1 and A2 annotation branches
T0.reference: A0 primary normal-control strata, fixed once

T_frozen.purpose: external transfer without external outcome-dependent restandardization
T_frozen.input: external source-label B_CONV donor pseudobulk raw counts
T_frozen.reference: the same discovery A0 normal-control gene means and SDs used by T0

T_rank.background: fixed disease-blind intersection of discovery and external gene symbols
T_rank.ties: average percentile rank after duplicate-symbol sum
T_rank.score: mean percentile rank of all 12 IFN/ISG genes
